Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the largest telematics service provider globally, founded in 2010 by two MIT professors. The company focuses on enhancing road safety and reducing driving-related costs through its AI-driven mobile sensing technology. CMT has pioneered smartphone-based solutions for usage-based and behavior-based insurance, powering over 70 enterprise programs in 25 countries. Its technology has helped prevent over 100,000 crashes and 68,000 injuries worldwide.

CMT offers an end-to-end AI-driven telematics platform called DriveWell Fusion®, which integrates data from various sources, including smartphones and connected vehicles. This platform helps identify and reduce driving risks, providing feedback to improve driver behavior. The company provides a suite of products, including risk management tools, claims solutions, engagement platforms, and video telematics. CMT serves a diverse range of clients, including auto insurers, automakers, commercial mobility companies, and public sector entities, with a presence in more than 20 countries.

Green Dot Corporation is a financial technology and registered bank holding company based in Austin, Texas, with operational offices in Provo, Utah. Founded in 1999, it is recognized as the world’s largest prepaid debit card company by market capitalization. Green Dot focuses on providing accessible financial tools to consumers and businesses, particularly those without traditional banking options. The company serves over 33 million customers directly and millions more through its extensive network of partners.

Green Dot offers a wide range of financial services, including cash transfer services, wage disbursement, tax refund processing, and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) through its embedded finance platform, Arc by Green Dot. Its product lineup features reloadable prepaid debit cards, gift cards, mobile banking accounts via GO2bank, secured credit programs, and private label cards. The company operates a vast retail network of over 95,000 locations, making its services widely accessible across the United States.

Propel(x) is an online investment platform founded in 2014, based in San Mateo, California, with operations in San Francisco. The platform connects accredited investors worldwide with early-stage Deep Tech and FinTech startups that focus on scientific discovery. Propel(x) allows investors to diversify their portfolios by investing in curated startups and hedge funds, with minimum investments typically starting at $3,000 to $5,000.

The company operates as an angel investing platform and offers SPVs-as-a-Service, focusing on financing technologies in sectors like Life Sciences, Energy, Aerospace, and Industrial Technologies. Propel(x) provides a unique online diligence process, enabling users to screen and invest in deals without traditional fees. Its services include curated deal flow, pooled investment vehicles (LLCs), and opportunities across various investment stages and asset classes. Propel(x) has facilitated over $1.5 billion in cumulative capital raised for its portfolio companies.

National Business Data Systems strives to help its customers achieve a higher level of profit by reducing overall inventory and carrying costs through a scientific optimization process in the cadence and quantity of inventory ordered. 
​
By capitalizing on both the history and recent trends in stock movement we are able to help our customers achieve cost reductions while maintaining or increasing the fill level on all inventory, and reducing or eliminating inventory on slow moving items.
​
The original software platform was built in consultation with Charles Bodenstab author of "A New Era in Inventory Management,"​ and has evolved over the years to the platform it is today in through ongoing efforts with our customers and partners.
 
NBDS was founded in 1972 and has a long and proud history of working with its customers to fulfill their needs.

FaceKey Corporation is a biometric security technology company based in San Antonio, Texas, founded in 1999. With a small team, FaceKey specializes in biometric-based access control systems, time and attendance tracking, visitor management, and muster stations. The company utilizes advanced face recognition and fingerprint identification technologies to provide reliable and cost-effective security solutions. Their systems support multiple authentication methods and are designed for easy installation and scalability, catering to both small businesses and large enterprises.

FaceKey's products focus on enhancing operational efficiency and employee safety while reducing the risks associated with traditional security methods. The company emphasizes durability and long-term value in its offerings, which are designed to adapt to economic challenges. With a commitment to data security and privacy, FaceKey has established itself as a leader in the biometric identification market, serving a diverse range of industries including manufacturing, oil and gas, and facilities management.

Integra Technologies Inc. is the largest U.S.-based Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) company, specializing in high-reliability semiconductor solutions. Founded in 1983 and headquartered in Wichita, Kansas, with additional facilities in Milpitas, California, and Albuquerque, New Mexico, Integra has established itself as a leader in semiconductor post-processing.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including die preparation, advanced packaging and assembly, electrical testing, and reliability qualification. Integra is particularly focused on mission-critical applications in sectors such as defense, aerospace, medical, automotive, and space. Its capabilities ensure dependable performance in high-stakes environments, including defense radars and avionics systems. Integra is committed to integrity, innovation, and inclusion, delivering secure and reliable semiconductor services tailored to the needs of its clients.

World Data Exchange is a data security software company based in Subiaco, Western Australia, founded in 2022. The company offers a borderless data exchange platform that connects various data sources, normalizes the data into a secure standalone store, and enables users to share consented data through a single API. This platform is designed for privacy-focused transactions.

The services provided by World Data Exchange cater to governments and enterprises, allowing them to manage personal information securely during everyday transactions. The platform supports secure data sharing across multiple sectors, including healthcare, retail, and government. Key features include secure data connectivity, data normalization, consent management, and privacy-by-design data mobility, empowering individuals to control how their personal data is shared.
